docs.hint: Front of DVLA photocard. Must show appropriate category (B for vans, C1 for 3.5–7.5T, C for HGV).
docs.name: Driving licence — front
docs.legal: Road Traffic Act 1988, s.87 — criminal offence to drive without valid licence

docs.hint: Back of photocard showing vehicle categories and any restrictions.
docs.name: Driving licence — back
docs.legal: Road Traffic Act 1988, s.87

docs.hint: Specific courier/delivery policy. Standard business use does NOT cover paid delivery work.
docs.name: Hire & Reward insurance
docs.legal: Road Traffic Act 1988, s.143 — criminal offence. £300 fine + 6 points + possible disqualification

docs.hint: Current and valid. Required annually from 3 years after first registration. Driving without valid MOT also voids insurance.
docs.name: MOT certificate
docs.legal: Road Traffic Act 1988, s.47 — offence to drive vehicle over 3 years old without valid MOT

docs.hint: UK/Irish passport, biometric residence permit, or Home Office online share code.
docs.name: Right to work evidence
docs.legal: Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006 — up to £60,000 penalty per illegal worker

docs.hint: Covers clients' cargo for theft, loss or damage while in transit. Min £10,000 recommended; most contracts require more.
docs.name: Goods in Transit insurance
docs.legal: Contractually required by most courier network contracts (DPD, Evri, Amazon Flex, HAF)

docs.hint: Min £1 million per claim. Covers injury or property damage to third parties from work activities.
docs.name: Public liability insurance
docs.legal: Contractually required by most platforms and commercial clients

docs.hint: Basic DBS disclosing unspent convictions. Enhanced + Barred List required for deliveries to schools/care homes.
docs.name: DBS check certificate
docs.legal: Standard delivery: best practice. Regulated activity: mandatory under Safeguarding Vulnerable Groups Act 2006

docs.hint: UTR (Unique Taxpayer Reference) — 10-digit number from HMRC confirming self-employed status.
docs.name: HMRC self-employment registration
docs.legal: Taxes Management Act 1970 — must notify HMRC of self-employment

docs.hint: Required only for drivers of vehicles over 3,500kg (Category C1/C lorries). NOT needed for standard van drivers.
docs.name: Driver CPC / DQC card
docs.legal: Road Traffic (Driver Licensing) Act 1989 — HGV/lorry drivers only

docs.hint: Required for vehicles over 3,500kg used for hire-and-reward. Standard National for UK work; Standard International for EU.
docs.name: Operator's licence
docs.legal: Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995 — HGV only

docs.hint: Companies House certificate confirming the business is legally registered as a UK company.
docs.name: Certificate of Incorporation
docs.legal: Companies Act 2006 — mandatory for limited companies

docs.hint: Min £1 million per claim. GOV.UK freight guidance states all forwarders should hold this.
docs.name: Public liability insurance
docs.legal: GOV.UK Freight forwarding: managing risk — mandatory in practice for all freight businesses

docs.hint: Min £5 million cover per claim. Required if the company employs anyone — even one person.
docs.name: Employer's liability insurance
docs.legal: Employers' Liability (Compulsory Insurance) Act 1969 — criminal offence not to hold it (£2,500/day fine)

docs.hint: Utility bill or bank letter dated within 3 months. Must show the registered trading address.
docs.name: Proof of business address
docs.legal: KYC/AML due diligence — Money Laundering Regulations 2017

docs.hint: GB EORI number from HMRC. Required for any business making customs declarations or importing/exporting.
docs.name: EORI number confirmation
docs.legal: Taxation (Cross-border Trade) Act 2018 — mandatory for customs declarations

docs.hint: Covers claims from errors, omissions or negligent customs/logistics advice causing client financial loss.
docs.name: Professional indemnity insurance
docs.legal: Contractually required by most clients; condition of BIFA membership

docs.hint: Covers clients' cargo for loss, theft or damage while in the forwarder's care. Required under BIFA STCs.
docs.name: Goods in Transit / cargo insurance
docs.legal: BIFA Standard Trading Conditions 2025; GOV.UK freight forwarding guidance

docs.hint: Required for international road freight. Covers statutory CMR liability (8.33 SDR per kg if goods lost or damaged).
docs.name: CMR insurance certificate
docs.legal: Carriage of Goods by Road Act 1965 — mandatory for international road carriage

docs.hint: Required if VAT registered. Threshold from April 2024: £90,000 taxable turnover in any 12-month period.
docs.name: VAT registration certificate
docs.legal: Value Added Tax Act 1994

docs.hint: British International Freight Association membership. Industry standard, expected by most major clients.
docs.name: BIFA membership certificate
docs.legal: Best practice; expected by contractual counterparties; limits liability under BIFA STCs 2025
